//: Config swaync tracciata (Stow package 'swaync'). Lo style.css è GENERATO
//2: da apply_theme.sh (concat colori pywal + style-body.css) → gitignored.

actions.command: sh -c '[[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]] && nmcli radio wifi on || nmcli radio wifi off'
actions.update-command: sh -c '[[ $(nmcli radio wifi) == "enabled" ]] && echo true || echo false'

actions.command: sh -c '[[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]] && rfkill unblock bluetooth || rfkill block bluetooth'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'rfkill list bluetooth | grep -q "Soft blocked: no" && echo true || echo false'

actions.command: sh -c 'if [[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]]; then setsid -f wlsunset -l 44.7 -L 10.6 >/dev/null 2>&1; else pkill -x wlsunset; fi'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'pgrep -x wlsunset >/dev/null && echo true || echo false'
sh -c 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface color-scheme | grep -q dark && echo true || echo false'

actions.command: sh -c '[[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]] && rfkill block all || rfkill unblock all'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'rfkill list | grep -q "Soft blocked: yes" && echo true || echo false'

actions.command: sh -c 'grim -g "$(slurp)" - | wl-copy -t image/png && notify-send "Screenshot" "Copiato negli appunti" -t 2000'
